title: A query library
description:
Write a small chainable query library for lists of records.

```lua
query(players):where(function(p) return p.level > 10 end):orderBy("score", "desc"):select("name"):take(3):list()
--> { "Cy", "Ada", "Dee" }
```
hints: Store the steps in the query object and run them only in `list()`, `count()` or `first()` (lesson 8.02).
`orderBy` needs every item, so it is the one step that cannot be lazy.
requirements: `query(list)` returns an object whose methods return new query objects (the original list is never changed).
`where`, `select` (a field name or a function), `orderBy(field, "asc"/"desc")`, `take(n)`, `count()`, `first()` and `list()`.
Steps are lazy where possible: `take(3)` after `where` stops filtering once it has three.
stretch: Add `groupBy(field)` returning a table of queries.
